# What is bundled in `static/js/vendor/`

`prosemirror.js` is a single build of the ProseMirror packages below, made
with esbuild from `bench/tbx/src/vendor.js`. It is here because this app has
no build step - `static/js/*.js` are served as plain scripts - so the
dependency is committed rather than fetched.

**Nothing is loaded from a network at runtime.** The app is a local server
and stays one; this file is served from disk like every other script.

Every package is under the **MIT licence**, which permits redistribution
inside a GPL-3.0 work. The full text of each is reproduced below, which is
what the MIT licence requires of anyone shipping it. See `NOTICE` for the
project-level statement.

Rebuild: `cd bench/tbx && node buildvendor.js`.
